description: TDNetGen is a MATLAB toolbox published by the SPS-L repository for generating synthetic combined transmission and distribution power-network models. Users choose characteristics such as the final system size and renewable-energy penetration in a parameters file, run the main script and obtain an exported test system in the output directory. The generated models support studies of transmission-distribution interactions, ancillary services, combined planning and operation, and emergency control across voltage levels. They are synthetic test networks, with no fixed geographic location, observation period or asset-level spatial resolution. Public MATLAB source and setup instructions are available free under MIT. Execution requires separately obtained MATLAB and MATPOWER, whose own licences apply; the open toolbox does not include those dependencies. The README reports tests with MATLAB 2015b and MATPOWER 5.1 and 6.0 across older Windows, Debian and macOS environments. Compatibility with newer releases was not established in this review. TDNetGen prepares benchmark inputs for the catalogue's MATPOWER model (model-matpower), not replacing its power-flow calculations. A linked research preprint explains the generator parameters in more detail.
